title: Kyiv Hydroelectric Power Plant
scope: Kyiv Hydroelectric Power Plant’s 288 m low spillway-powerhouse exterior with paired recessed bays, two blue gantries, control tower, downstream quay walls, navigation lock and road bridge.
axis: +X runs east-southeast along the main crown road and +Z runs south-southwest downstream.

groundCutout.basis: Limit openings to the powerhouse, lock chamber and two mapped concrete quay faces. Keep nearby banks and approaches. The bridge corridor covers only the mapped lock crossing.

heightPolicy: The signed vertical origin is 98.004144 m. The crest road is approximately 107.2 m. The design review uses 103 m headwater, 91.5 m tailwater and 96.1 m illustrative chamber stage.
limitations: The published exterior reference dates are August 2018 for the plant and June 2021 for the lock. The model records that appearance, and current repair-era exterior and equipment are unverified.
The crest road, lock and bridge are located from PMTiles. Gate elevations, the low crown grade and some equipment dimensions are exterior approximations.

The standard terrain gives 98.65 m upstream and 90.65 m downstream. The illustrative lock chamber, closed gate configuration and static water are review fixtures. Adjacent dikes and buildings stay native.
